events.title: Next Fest is live - Demo Update 0.3.1
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has started!The demo has been for some time now and Next Fest is finally here, so we've made a little update! What's new:A brand new space backgroundThe Void now shows a little warning... if you know where to lookMerchants have a new animation of flying in and out of the stationEnergy rebalance for a smooth startCat Day is now real 🐱A lot of fixes and polishingFull version will come Q1 2027If you haven't tried our demo yet, this week is the perfect time. If you enjoy it, wishlist

events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo version
events.summary: Hi architects!We’ve prepared a major update for Astro Architect, introducing new systems, reworking existing mechanics, improving UX and game balance, and adding many new ways to manage your station.This version will be available as the Demo during the Steam Next Fest on 19-26th October.We invite you to jump into the new demo and give it a try!🏢 Factions, Management & Employee ProgressionFaction system and faction management board, which affects votingFaction tasks and needsTechnology tree based

events.title: Second Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Hi architects! DemoWe have just released the second demo version of the game. You can play it now! Feedback All your feedback will be appreciated and will have impact on how the final game looks and plays. There's a special section in Steam Community Hub for telling us what you think, but feel free to create your own threads there. There's also dedicated in game function to leave us feedback or report any bugs. Your Frost Crown Studio
